title: El año viejo
desc: Burning the year on the pavement at midnight
setting: Roberto arrives at seven in the morning on the thirty-first with an armful of old clothes and a plan.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: Hay que hacer el muñeco. ¿Tenés ropa vieja?
steps.en: We have to make the dummy. Have you got old clothes?

options.es: Debo tener algo. ¿De qué lo vamos a hacer?
options.en: I must have something. What are we going to make it out of?
options.feedback: You did not ask what a muñeco is, you asked what it is made of. That is somebody joining in rather than being told about it.
Fair question. He is going to look at you as though you were born yesterday, which he will anyway.

options.en: I have nothing to throw out.
options.feedback: You do. Lucía is already holding the shirt she has hated for two years.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: Del año viejo. Se quema a medianoche.
steps.en: Of the old year. It gets burned at midnight.

options.en: And why is it burned? Tell me.
options.feedback: Asking for the reason instead of the instructions. He is seventeen and delighted to be the one who knows.
You do not, quite, and there is a good answer available for free.
Twenty fires on one dirt street. It is, and that is not the interesting part.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: Todo lo malo del año se le mete adentro.
steps.en: Everything bad from the year gets stuffed inside it.

options.es: Entonces este año le vamos a meter bastante.
options.en: Then this year we are going to stuff plenty in.
options.feedback: You took the idea and made a joke of it that is also true. That is exactly the register of the thirty-first.
Warm, and it treats a custom like a suggestion.

options.es: Yo no creo en esas cosas.
options.en: I do not believe in those things.
options.feedback: Nobody asked you to believe. They asked you to help stuff a shirt with newspaper.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: A las doce lo quemamos todos juntos.
steps.en: At twelve we all burn them together.

options.en: I will be there. Do we need matches?
options.feedback: Committed and thought one step ahead. That is somebody who is in it rather than watching it.
Accepted. Bringing something is what turns watching into taking part.
From inside the house, on the one night when the whole street is outside.
